integrity: General Gaussian score identity and scalar noise-weighted comparator were published previously; only the specialized explicit gains, strict direction inversion, logarithmic asymptotics and quantified scalar-diagnostic blind spot are assessed. Numerical tests support, not prove, the theorem.
scientific_limitations: Local mean response of a single real 1-by-2 row under centered diagonal-covariance Gaussian noise. Not a convergence theorem; limits not uniform in both signal and anisotropy. Older directional-statistics equivalents remain possible.
title: Logarithmic directional response hidden by scalar calibration for anisotropic Gaussian polar updates
